grammar.topic: 2nd conditional: if + past simple, would + verb
explainTr: Gerçek olmayan veya hayali durumları anlatırken 2nd conditional kullanırsın: If + past simple, would + yalın fiil. If I were a teacher, I would be patient. Geçmiş zaman kullanmana rağmen burada geçmişten söz etmiyorsun; hayal kuruyorsun.
'Be' fiili için tüm öznelerle 'were' kullanılır: If I were you... (Günlük konuşmada 'was' da duyabilirsin.) 'If I would be' diye bir yapı yoktur; if'ten sonra would gelmez.
Tavsiye vermek için çok kullanışlı: If I were you, I would talk to the principal. (Senin yerinde olsam müdürle konuşurdum.) Soru da kolay: What would you do if you ...?
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'öğretmen olsaydım, sabırlı olurdum' diye -sa/-ır yapısıyla kurarsın. İngilizcede If I were a teacher (if + geçmiş), I would be patient (would + fiil) olur. Eğer 'olsaydım'ı would ile çevirirsen (If I would be) yanlış olur.

reading.title: If I were a teacher
reading.text:
Hafsa has a small notebook where she writes her dreams. Last night she wrote a new page: "If I were a full-time teacher..."

"If I were a teacher, I would be patient with every child. I would not be too strict, but I would be fair. If a student made a mistake, I would not laugh. I would say, 'Good try! Let's try again.' Praise helps children improve, and it makes them feel safe.

I would also make my lessons creative. If I taught English, I would bring pictures and songs to class. If the children were tired, we would play a short game. I think children learn more when they enjoy the lesson.

What would I do if a child had a problem at home? I would listen first, and then I would talk to the school counselor. I would never ignore a sad child.

Of course, I would need more English and more experience. If I had a magic wand, I would speak perfect English tomorrow!"

But Hafsa knows there is no magic. She studies every day, and every week her English gets better. "Maybe my dream is not so far away," she writes, and she closes the notebook with a smile.

script.text: Hafsa, imagine you're the principal of Lincoln Elementary. What would you change?

script.text: Wow, that's a big question. I would start with lunch. I would make the lunch break longer.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: If children had more time, they would eat better and play more.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I would ask parents to help in the classrooms. If more adults were there, every child would get attention.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Not less, but shorter. If homework were short, children would finish it and feel proud.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I like that. You know, if I were you, I would apply for a teaching assistant job.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I can help you with the application form.

script.speaker: Hafsa

writing.promptTr: 'Öğretmen olsaydım ...' başlıklı kısa bir paragraf yaz. En az dört would cümlesi kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a short paragraph: If I were a teacher, what would you do? Use at least four sentences with would.
frames: If I were a teacher, I would ...
If a child felt ..., I would ...
writing.model: If I were a teacher, I would teach young children. I would be patient and kind, but I would also be fair. Every morning, I would greet each child at the door. If a child felt nervous, I would sit next to him and listen. I would make my lessons creative, with songs, pictures and games. I would also call the parents with good news, not only with problems. If I had a big classroom, I would build a reading corner with soft chairs. Children would love books more. I think a good teacher can change a child's life, and that is my dream.
checklistTr: If cümlende past simple (veya were), sonuçta would + yalın fiil var mı?
'If I would be' gibi bir hata yok, değil mi?
Paragrafta en az dört would cümlesi var mı?
